sql: SELECT t, (xpath('/row/m/text()', query_to_xml(format('SELECT max(created_at)::date AS m FROM public.%I', t), false, true, '')))[1]::text AS ultima, (xpath('/row/n/text()', query_to_xml(format('SELECT count(*) AS n FROM public.%I WHERE created_at > now() - interval ''30 days''', t), false, true, '')))[1]::text AS n30 FROM unnest(ARRAY['daily_summaries', 'monthly_reviews', 'campaigns', 'campaign_images', 'b2b_leads', 'support_tickets', 'partner_products', 'hub_recruitment_responses', 'conversation_flows', 'flow_lead_state', 'flow_nodes', 'company_landing_pages', 'company_onboarding', 'base_leads', 'cardapio_responses', 'contrato_responses', 'prefesta_responses', 'evaluation_responses', 'freelancer_responses', 'freelancer_schedules', 'freelancer_assignments', 'attendance_entries', 'maintenance_entries', 'party_monitoring_entries', 'event_staff_entries', 'event_checklist_items', 'company_tasks', 'company_expenses', 'company_revenues', 'generated_contracts', 'contract_signatures', 'pre_reservations', 'lead_visits', 'visit_confirmation_history', 'reactivation_execution_log', 'lead_reactivation_history', 'client_data_requests', 'sales_materials', 'message_templates', 'wapi_bot_questions', 'ai_sim_runs', 'backup_logs', 'activity_logs', 'financial_consents', 'event_payments', 'campaign_recipients', 'whatsapp_outbound_queue', 'password_reset_logs', 'freelancer_invites']) AS t WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns ic WHERE ic.table_schema = 'public' AND ic.table_name = t AND ic.column_name = 'created_at') ORDER BY 2 NULLS FIRST
